messages.en:
{07 19 00}Fossils can be really hard
to find{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}That's why it's so cool to
actually find one, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Fossiile võib olla väga
raske leida{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}Sellepärast ongi nii lahe
tõesti üks leida,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}If you ever find a 
freakishly rare fossil{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 04 00}Oh, wait{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Never mind.{01 01 00}
{07 14 00}You're gonna have to figure
it out for yourself.

{07 19 00}My whole life I've felt this
cosmic thread connecting
me to fossils.
{07 15 00}If I ever see one, I'm going
to yank on it until I find 
the other end, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Kogu elu olen tundnud seda
kosmilist niiti, mis mind
fossiilidega ühendab.
{07 15 00}Kui ma ühte näen, tõmban
seda, kuni leian
teise otsa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
